senses.sense_definition: A term of address for a group of people.

examples.text: Come on, my <w>livelies</w>, we have a lot of work to do today.

target_lang_translations.pl: Dalej, moje <w>żywe</w> srebra, mamy dziś dużo pracy.
target_lang_translations.de: Kommt schon, meine <w>Energiebündel</w>, wir haben heute viel zu tun.
target_lang_translations.fr: Allez, mes <w>amis</w>, nous avons beaucoup de travail à faire aujourd'hui.
target_lang_translations.it: Forza, <w>ragazzi</w>, abbiamo molto lavoro da fare oggi.

target_lang_translations.zh: 来吧，<w>伙计们</w>，我们今天有很多活要干。

examples.text: Listen up, my <w>livelies</w>, the ship is leaving the harbor soon.
